answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the ivory is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The beacon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the onyx is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
